+#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
+//! Unified feature-gated CLI library for Rotameter.
+
+use rotameter_core::ComponentInfo;
+
+/// Returns metadata for all workspace components compiled under the active feature set.
+pub fn enabled_components() -> Vec<ComponentInfo> {
+    let components = [
+        rotameter_core::component_info(),
+        rotameter_client::component_info(),
+        #[cfg(feature = "server")]
+        rotameter_server::component_info(),
+        #[cfg(feature = "sqlite")]
+        rotameter_store_sqlite::component_info(),
+        #[cfg(feature = "mcp")]
+        rotameter_mcp::component_info(),
+        #[cfg(feature = "tui")]
+        rotameter_tui::component_info(),
+    ];
+    components.to_vec()
+}
+
+/// Formats the CLI version banner listing enabled workspace components.
+pub fn version_banner() -> String {
+    let names: Vec<&'static str> = enabled_components().into_iter().map(|c| c.name).collect();
+    format!(
+        "rotameter {} ({})",
+        rotameter_core::WORKSPACE_VERSION,
+        names.join(", ")
+    )
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    #[test]
+    fn enabled_components_match_workspace_version() {
+        let components = enabled_components();
+        let names: Vec<&str> = components.iter().map(|c| c.name).collect();
+
+        assert!(names.contains(&"rotameter-core"));
+        assert!(names.contains(&"rotameter-client"));
+        #[cfg(feature = "server")]
+        assert!(names.contains(&"rotameter-server"));
+        #[cfg(feature = "sqlite")]
+        assert!(names.contains(&"rotameter-store-sqlite"));
+        #[cfg(feature = "mcp")]
+        assert!(names.contains(&"rotameter-mcp"));
+        #[cfg(feature = "tui")]
+        assert!(names.contains(&"rotameter-tui"));
+
+        for component in components {
+            assert_eq!(component.version, rotameter_core::WORKSPACE_VERSION);
+        }
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn version_banner_lists_core_and_client() {
+        let banner = version_banner();
+        assert!(banner.starts_with("rotameter "));
+        assert!(banner.contains("rotameter-core"));
+        assert!(banner.contains("rotameter-client"));
+    }
+}

+#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
+//! Pure domain logic, types, and storage trait contracts for Rotameter.
+//!
+//! This crate is intentionally free of OS I/O, async runtimes, and storage engines.
+
+/// Lockstep workspace semantic version shared by all Rotameter crates.
+pub const WORKSPACE_VERSION: &str = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION");
+
+/// Static identity metadata for a compiled Rotameter workspace crate.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ComponentInfo {
+    /// Crate name as declared in its manifest.
+    pub name: &'static str,
+    /// Crate version in lockstep with the workspace.
+    pub version: &'static str,
+}
+
+/// Returns static metadata describing `rotameter-core`.
+///
+/// # Examples
+///
+/// ```
+/// let info = rotameter_core::component_info();
+/// assert_eq!(info.name, "rotameter-core");
+/// assert_eq!(info.version, rotameter_core::WORKSPACE_VERSION);
+/// ```
+pub const fn component_info() -> ComponentInfo {
+    ComponentInfo {
+        name: "rotameter-core",
+        version: WORKSPACE_VERSION,
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    #[test]
+    fn core_component_metadata_is_populated() {
+        let info = component_info();
+        assert_eq!(info.name, "rotameter-core");
+        assert_ne!(info.version, "");
+    }
+}

+# Adopt opaque prefixed UUIDv7 UIDs, site-scoped dictionaries, and SaaS seams
+
+## Context and Problem Statement
+
+Rotameter `v1.0` starts as a single-binary self-hosted engine on a `1 vCPU / 1 GB RAM` VM, while remaining cleanly extensible into a multi-tenant hosted SaaS (`rotameter-cloud`) in the future without breaking public APIs or requiring table rewrites. Using mutable domain strings as primary keys (`site_id = "colinwolff.dev"`) and sharing a global `dim_strings` dictionary across sites breaks when domains change, causes cross-tenant collisions, and widens composite `WITHOUT ROWID` indexes.
+
+## Decision Drivers
+
+* Immutable site identity so domain or slug renames never rewrite `events`, `sessions`, or `rollups_*`.
+* Cross-tenant isolation for future multi-tenant SaaS (`org_id` tenancy and per-site `dim_strings`).
+* Compact fixed-width foreign keys (`16`-byte `BLOB` UUIDv7) in hot `WITHOUT ROWID` tables on `1 GB` VMs.
+* Effortless single-operator self-hosting UX (transparent default org and `<site>` resolution by `site_id` or `slug`).
+* Open-source workspace remains `MIT OR Apache-2.0` and strictly zero-phone-home; any future SaaS control plane (`rotameter-cloud`) stays external.
+
+## Considered Options
+
+* TypeID-style prefixed UUIDv7 UIDs (`org_...`, `site_...`, `key_...`) + `slug` + `display_name`, site-scoped `dim_strings`, `SaltProvider`, and per-site `IngestPolicy` seams
+* Keep domain strings (`TEXT`) as `site_id` primary keys with a global `dim_strings` dictionary
+
+## Decision Outcome
+
+Chosen option: "TypeID-style prefixed UUIDv7 UIDs (`org_...`, `site_...`, `key_...`) + `slug` + `display_name`, site-scoped `dim_strings`, `SaltProvider`, and per-site `IngestPolicy` seams", because `16`-byte binary UUIDv7 keys shrink `events` and `sessions` storage while guaranteeing tenant isolation, clean renames, and zero-effort self-hosted defaults.
+
+### Consequences
+
+* Good, because `orgs`, `sites`, and `api_keys` serialize as self-describing Crockford base32 strings (`org_<26>`, `site_<26>`, `key_<26>`) in JSON/CLI while storing as compact `16`-byte `BLOB` (SQLite) or `UUID` (`v2.0` PostgreSQL).
+* Good, because `sites` enforces `UNIQUE(org_id, slug)` while allowing mutable `slug` and `display_name` updates in place.
+* Good, because `dim_strings(id, site_id, kind, value)` enforces `UNIQUE(site_id, kind, value)` with `ON DELETE CASCADE`, eliminating cross-tenant leakage and simplifying erasure.
+* Good, because `SaltProvider` (`rotameter-core`, `RM-4`) and per-site `IngestPolicy` (`rotameter-server`, `RM-8`) allow multi-node salt sharing and per-plan quotas in `rotameter-cloud` without altering OSS core logic.
+* Neutral, because first-boot self-hosted initialization seeds one transparent local default organization (`slug = "default"`), and CLI/MCP/TUI accept either `site_id` or `slug`.
+
+### Confirmation
+
+* `RM-3` and `RM-4` implement prefixed UUIDv7 `OrgId`/`SiteId`/`KeyId` types and the `SaltProvider` trait in `rotameter-core`.
+* `RM-5` implements `orgs`, `sites`, `api_keys`, and site-scoped `dim_strings` in `0001_initial.sql`.
+* `RM-7` and `RM-8` implement `POST`/`PUT` `/v1/admin/sites`, `site_id`/`slug` lookup, and the `IngestPolicy` hook.
+
+## Pros and Cons of the Options
+
+### Prefixed UUIDv7 UIDs + `slug`/`display_name` + SaaS seams
+
+* Good, zero migration pain between single-node self-hosting and multi-tenant cloud hosting.
+* Bad, adds small base32 encode/decode boilerplate in `rotameter-core` (`RM-3`).
+
+### Mutable domain strings as primary keys
+
+* Bad, renames break history, two orgs cannot track the same domain, and `dim_strings` leaks across sites.
+
